item.title: Honey Badger Wars 5. He Picked The Wrong Burrow — What Happened Next Is Brutal
item.description:
HONEY BADGER WARS PART 5 — in this episode, one honey badger picks the wrong burrow, and the fight that follows rewrites the rules of animal survival.
A honey badger (ratel) has one of the most brutal survival records in Africa: venom-resistant, thick-skinned, and built to fight things ten times its size. But when a honey badger picks the wrong burrow, "fearless" stops being a strategy and becomes a problem.
This episode is the full breakdown of what happened — the animal fights, the predator vs prey physics, and the science of why almost nothing can kill a honey badger.In this episode: • Why the honey badger attacks and survives what it shouldn't • Honey badger vs snake — cobra, black mamba and python venom science • What happens when a honey badger vs lion confrontation goes wrong • Why a honey badger burrow is a warzone, not a shelter • The real biology behind Africa's most dangerous animalsHoney Badger Wars — full series: Part 1 → Part 2 → Part 3 → Part 4
